fusions.name: Puffball Slam
fusions.desc: A puffball bursts at your feet, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles. Each is left [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Pressing Rot
fusions.desc: A crushing shove that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It costs 5% of your maximum health, and you heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Brace of Hyphae
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Bruising Fruit
fusions.desc: When you land a strike, your physical damage rises 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
